game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · History/classification review
game_concept: A puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents, a tented desert bazaar: the oasis keeper must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bazaar Tents: a tented desert bazaar
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
player_objective: Case 5: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about History/classification review.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Code Reading Relay' (Week 9 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Bazaar Tents'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.
Open Evidence to review the records and verify your findings.
source_player_objective: Reach the sandstone arch using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The sandstone arch reached with actions_used <= 11.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the sandstone arch is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Code Reading Relay – Bazaar Tents Trial
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
